title: Synchronize Diagram Pan And Zoom
summary:
Fixed three root causes for empty diagram and missing 3D models in the MCP App:

1. **Diagram payload truncation fix** (`main.py` `_build_app_payload`): For diagram-only modes (`show-diagram`, `show-diagram-diff`, `select-pieces`, `select-connections`, `select-pieces-and-connections`), `kit` is now omitted from the payload. This reduces payload from ~2.5MB to ~160KB (design + kitArtifacts + points + lines), well under host truncation limits. The JS `McpDiagramViewer` falls back to the Python-enriched design (which has centers computed by `_enrich_design`/`flattenDesignDict`) when `kit` is absent.

2. **Missing 3D models fix** (`main.py` `_select_best_model_file_guids`): Added GLB fallback search mirroring JS `buildScenePieceAssets` (lines 2110-2118 in index.tsx). If the best model (first untagged or first) has a non-GLB file, the function now searches ALL models for any GLB/GLTF file to inline. Previously, types like base/tambour/capsule/capital whose first model wasn't a GLB had no file inlined, so the JS loaded from HTTP URLs which were CSP-blocked. Also extracted `_is_gltf_file` helper.

3. **Rebuilt `semio/engine/dist/mcp-app.html`** (7.0MB, 3629 modules). All 175 engine tests pass.
